text:
IncidentBot: ALERT: preemptible GPU pool 'spot-usw2-gpu' experiencing rapid preemptions. queue_length +480% in 10m; active evictions 62. Severity: P1. Paging oncall-ml.
Adele: I'm taking this. seeing a flood of jobs stuck in queue. enqueued -> throttled. api error rate climbing.
Oncall-ML: I'm on it. grabbing autoscaler logs now. can someone post recent kube events? @Ryan can you check cloud console quotas?
Ryan: checking. quotas look OK but there are a bunch of spot terminations in us-west-2 batch. provider shows reclaim on several GPU types.
Sophie: autoscaler error: "MaxPoolSizeReached" in the logs. Pool config says max 50 gpus, current desired 50 -> can't scale further. only 12 reserved dedicated gpus available.
Adele: impact: user-facing generation latency tail > 5s for many requests, 502 spikes. top affected customers: alpha and beta orgs. no data leak.
Kyler: digging into fallback routing. policy should fall back to low-cost dedicated or to smaller model. looks like routing rules only allow fallback if pool has spare capacity; none available.
Oncall-ML: running quick mitigation: disable non-critical batch jobs and try to drain ephemeral queues.
Adele: runbook step 3: 'enable emergency_dedicated_capacity' - needs infra approval. @Maria can you grant temp increase? we need +8 gpus.
Maria: granting +8 dedicated GPUs from reserved pool now. ETA ~3m to be provisioned.
IncidentBot: EVENT: dedicated pool 'dedicated-usw2-gpu' scaling +8 requested by Maria. deploy-job-id: dj-4521
Ryan: also opening cloud support ticket for spot reclaim pattern — might be provider maintenance. ticket 789101.
Sophie: autoscaler still failing to reassign pods: error snippet:
```
Error: insufficient resources: requested 10 x nvidia-t4, available 0
Reason: preemptions and k8s taints
```
Adele: temp workaround: update routing policy to allow model size downshift for best-effort requests. I'm flipping the flag in console.
Adele: changed route: /generate -> model=falcon-7b-quant if dedicated capacity < 10. :gear: 
Kyler: confirmed fallback on small cohort of requests. tail latency improving for best-effort customers. production SLOs still breached for reserved customers.
Oncall-ML: note — autoscaler max config is intentionally conservative. long-term action: raise maxPool for spot to 80 with guardrail + pre-warm. filing issue: INF-2319.
Zach: customer facing comms: drafting. Will notify affected customers and explain fallback; ask for patience while we stabilize. ETA 15m for first mail.
Adele: handoff summary for next shift (@Oncall-ML -> @Kyler): cause = spot/preemptible storm + autoscaler hit maxPool; mitigation = reclaimed reserved dedicated + route downshift + cancel noncritical batches; next actions = raise pool limits, investigate provider maintenance, formalize emergency capacity policy.
Kyler: ack. I'll be on bridge for the next 2h and will watch queues. set incident to 'investigating' -> 'stabilized' when tail latency < 1s for 15m.
Maria: dedicated capacity added. pods starting to schedule. verifying logs now.
IncidentBot: UPDATE: queue length down to +70% vs +480%. error-rate trending down. Metrics: 95th latency 1.8s -> 0.9s. Still monitoring.
Oncall-ML: logging long-term tasks in backlog: (1) change autoscaler max, (2) add emergency reserved pool, (3) improve routing policy to allow partial fallback, (4) add preempt tip-off to jobs. tagging infra and runtime.
Adele: closing bridge in 30m if metrics stable. good work team. :thumbsup: 
Zach: sent customer note to affected alpha orgs, flagged as high impact.
Adele: handoff complete. next update by Kyler on any regressions.
